subject.title: fix(msteams): paginate thread replies to include newest context (#98870)

question: After the test defects are fixed, should this external Teams Graph pagination PR wait for redacted live over-50-reply Teams or Graph proof, or can maintainers explicitly accept source and unit proof for this bugfix?
rationale: The code boundary is clear, but the changed behavior depends on live Microsoft Graph pagination, timestamp ordering, latency, and throttling behavior that unit tests cannot prove.

options.title: Require live proof after test fixes
options.body: Fix the test defects, then require redacted Teams or Graph output showing a real channel thread with more than 50 replies includes the newest context and note latency or throttling behavior.

options.title: Accept source and unit proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly own the live Graph risk after the test defects are fixed, leaving real tenant validation for follow-up.

recommendation.title: Require live proof after test fixes
recommendation.body: Fix the test defects, then require redacted Teams or Graph output showing a real channel thread with more than 50 replies includes the newest context and note latency or throttling behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: BradGroux approved and merged the original Teams thread-history feature and is the strongest available owner signal for the live Microsoft Teams proof decision.
